text:
Kim: rcvd alerts: surge in mTLS handshake rejects from ap-southeast and eu-west starting 03:40 UTC. Logs show KMS Decrypt AccessDenied during cert unwrap.
Vik: saw it too. Our cert-rotator job ran at 03:35 and I landed an RBAC tighten for the rotator role last night. Might be related.
Jin: sample log: `2026-07-12T03:41:12Z proxy-eu unwrap err: KMS:AccessDenied Decrypt for arn:aws:sts::123456:assumed-role/cert-rotator`
Rosa: oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-3021 created and assigned to eng-security.
oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-3021 created and assigned to eng-security.
Kim: immediate mitigation options: (1) revert RBAC change (fast), (2) enable a short local-keystore fallback (operator-only), (3) force cert-rotator to use regional KMS keys (longer).
Vik: I'll roll back the RBAC tweak now and post the change id. Also adding an EncryptionContext field `service=proxy` to decrypts so CloudTrail links denies to requests.
Jin: Please add a CloudTrail quick search snippet to the runbook: 
```
fields @timestamp, eventName, userIdentity.arn, requestParameters
| filter eventName = "Decrypt" and errorMessage like /AccessDenied/
| sort @timestamp desc | limit 100
```
Rosa: Rollback applied: rb-2026-77 at 03:44 UTC. Decrypt success rate improving. Monitoring 30m.
Kim: For followups: (a) policy-emulator CI gate for KMS policy changes that simulates decrypts from rotated egress principals, (b) emit metric `iam.kms.rollout{change_id}` on policy deploy, (c) add an automated smoke decrypt from each region post-policy deploy.
Vik: Agree. I'll open PRs for the emulator and for adding encrypt context tags.
Jin: Also add OCSP/CRL check in the rotator smoke test so certs are validated end-to-end.
Rosa: Filing tickets: ENGSEC-4012 (postmortem + policy audit), INFRA-3004 (keystore-fallback operator flag), TOOLING-1102 (policy emulator).
Kim: Thanks everyone. We'll keep monitoring and schedule a short postmortem. :thumbsup:
